name: quarantine
description: Wraps web, MCP and third-party tool output as untrusted data and defangs prompt-injection lines before the model reads them

trustedMcpServers.title: Trusted MCP servers
trustedMcpServers.description: Comma-separated MCP server names whose output is not quarantined (e.g. serena,context7)

quarantineVendorReads.title: Quarantine vendored files
quarantineVendorReads.description: Treat Read of files under node_modules/, vendor/, Downloads/ and similar as untrusted

quarantineAllShell.title: Quarantine all shell output
quarantineAllShell.description: Wrap every Bash/PowerShell result, not only commands recognised as fetching remote text (safest; noisier)
